name: Billy Doe Meats
verdict: The biggest movement for Billy Doe Meats is a sharp 69.16% drop in Google Business Profile actions over the last 7 days, likely driven by reduced local search visibility or seasonal dip in foot traffic intent. Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend and activity over the 28-day window, so organic GBP engagement (562 total actions, including 40 calls, 94 directions, and 428 web clicks) remains the sole traffic driver to monitor closely.

performance.verdict: Paid ads fully dark; organic GBP collapse and 5 overdue SOW gates demand immediate attention.

findings.text: 4 milestones overdue by 2026-08-31: Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership, Funnel Test + UTM Live, SEO Phase 1 — renewal launched Aug 1 but these blockers are unresolved.
Live-Cooking Shoot (Shoot 1) overdue since 2026-08-14; no completed event recorded — 22 days past deadline, real-footage creative pipeline is stalled.
Zero paid spend across all channels for the entire 45-day series; ROAS and purchases are unmeasurable — no paid ecom activity has run since tracking began.
GBP actions dropped 69.16% (7d delta); last 3 days in series show 0 actions vs prior-3 average of 34.3 — likely a data-feed gap, not a true organic collapse, but unconfirmed.
GA4 sessions up 10.12% (7d); last 3 days average 333 vs prior-3 average of 265 — organic site interest is rising with zero paid support, which amplifies the cost of continued ad inactivity.

suggestions.text: Resolve Funnel Test + UTM Live gate: close /halal-subscribe test (code ihbp8pmtn8) and push UTM tagging before any spend resumes.
suggestions.monday_update: The /halal-subscribe conversion test (100%-off code ihbp8pmtn8) was due closed by 2026-08-31 and is still open, blocking proper attribution before paid relaunch. Zero paid spend has run in 45 days (F3), meaning every dollar spent at relaunch will land without UTM tracking if this is not resolved first. Success check: UTM parameters firing on all paid URLs confirmed in Windsor before the first Meta campaign goes live. Target resolution: 2026-09-08.

suggestions.text: Verify GBP data feed for Sept 1–4 zero-action gap; confirm whether 69% drop is a reporting outage or real visibility loss.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions show 0 for each of the last 4 days in the series (Sept 1–4) versus a prior-3-day average of 34.3 actions per day (F4). This is likely a data-feed outage rather than a true organic collapse, but it must be confirmed by checking GBP Insights directly in Google Business dashboard. Success check: actions data resumes populating or a real-traffic cause is identified. Target: 2026-09-08 re-check.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 session growth (avg 333/day last 3 days); if paid ads relaunch by Sept 12, use this as the pre-spend organic baseline.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions are averaging 333/day over the last 3 days versus 265 in the prior 3 days, with zero paid spend (F3, F5). This organic lift should be documented as the baseline before any Meta campaign goes live so incremental paid impact can be isolated. No action is warranted until paid activity resumes. Re-check 2026-09-12 to confirm baseline is stable and paid launch is imminent.
